subject.title: fix: deliver background task completions through owning sessions

question: Should this PR require Telegram-visible owner-session delivery proof before merge, or may maintainers accept source-level tests and CI for this session-routing fix?
rationale: The code path looks narrow, but the behavior is visible in Telegram topic/session delivery and the current proof is source and CI only, so automation should not waive the live-proof gate on its own.

options.title: Require Live Owner-Session Proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted Telegram Desktop recording, gateway logs, terminal/live output, or linked artifact showing the completion reaches the owning topic/session with heartbeat isolation enabled.

options.title: Accept Source-Only Proof
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally merge with tests and source evidence only, while owning the risk that real transport/session delivery still misroutes or loses the final message.

options.title: Pause For Broader Delivery Contract
options.body: If maintainers want one task-completion wake contract across background-task, ACP, exec, and subagent paths, pause this PR and fold the useful tests into that design.

recommendation.title: Require Live Owner-Session Proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted Telegram Desktop recording, gateway logs, terminal/live output, or linked artifact showing the completion reaches the owning topic/session with heartbeat isolation enabled.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is the strongest current-main history match across the inspected heartbeat, task delivery, and subagent announce paths.
